theorems.statement: ∀ (Δ : Subgroup (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ)) (S : Set UpperHalfPlane), MeasurableSet S → (∀ᵐ z ∂(MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane), z ∈ S) → ∃ X : Set UpperHalfPlane, MeasurableSet X ∧ (∀ᵐ z ∂(MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane), z ∈ X) ∧ X ⊆ S ∧ (∀ (γ : Δ) (z : UpperHalfPlane), (γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) • z ∈ X ↔ z ∈ X)
